reserveReview.rationale: stUSDS participates in Sky's risk-capital module and is economically exposed to the SKY-backed loan receivable rather than holding a simple cash reserve. The exact direct exposure is therefore one protocol position with explicit credit, concentration, market, liquidity, and smart-contract risks.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live single-asset row, pinned stUSDS design, and deployed contract
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No additional direct stUSDS reserve slice is identified; borrower performance and risk-capital realization remain structured risks of the classified position.
